description: Platform-neutral grid viewport, axes, snapping and virtualization geometry for Ankhorage.

exports.name: constrainViewport
exports.description: Constrain a viewport to finite world bounds while preserving valid unconstrained viewports.

exports.name: getAxisCategoryTicks
exports.description: Project variable-width category starts into visible-only major ruler tick candidates.

signatures.label: (viewport: GridViewport, axis: GridAxisName, categories: readonly GridAxisCategory[]) => readonly GridAxisCategoryTick[]

exports.name: getAxisTicks
exports.description: Generate only visible ruler ticks; a domain adapter may supply irregular boundaries.

signatures.label: (viewport: GridViewport, axis: GridAxisName, specification: GridTickSpecification, provider?: GridTickProvider | undefined) => readonly GridAxisTick[]

exports.name: getVisibleGridItems
exports.description: Cull offscreen rectangular items without materializing logical grid cells.

signatures.label: (items: readonly T[], viewport: GridViewport, overscanPixels?: number) => readonly T[]

exports.name: getVisibleWorldBounds
exports.description: Calculate the visible world rectangle, optionally expanded by pixel overscan.

exports.name: panViewport
exports.description: Pan by pixel displacement; dragging to the right reveals world coordinates to the left.

signatures.label: (viewport: GridViewport, displacement: GridPoint, constraints?: GridViewportConstraints | undefined) => GridViewport

exports.name: revealWorldRect
exports.description:
Minimally pans a viewport so that a world rectangle is visible inside pixel padding.
Oversized rectangles align their leading edges because neither axis can show them in full.

signatures.label: (viewport: GridViewport, rect: GridRect, paddingPixels?: number, constraints?: GridViewportConstraints | undefined) => GridViewport

exports.name: snapWorldCoordinate
exports.description: Snap a world coordinate without consulting zoom or grid-line density.

signatures.label: (value: number, specification: GridSnapSpecification, resolver?: GridSnapResolver | undefined) => number

exports.name: viewportToWorld
exports.description: Transform a viewport pixel coordinate back into world space.

exports.name: worldToViewport
exports.description: Transform stable world coordinates to screen pixels.

exports.name: zoomViewportAt
exports.description: Zoom around a fixed pixel focal point without moving its underlying world coordinate.

signatures.label: (viewport: GridViewport, focalPoint: GridPoint, nextScale: Pick<GridViewport, "pixelsPerUnitX" | "pixelsPerUnitY">, limits?: GridZoomLimits, constraints?: GridViewportConstraints | undefined) => GridViewport
